blurb: Guests cruise aboard the classic 42' Grand Banks yacht, the Rainbird, enjoying Seattle waterfront views including landmarks and wildlife. Cruises are private for groups up to 6 people, with a captain providing narration and navigation. The vessel is fully enclosed and equipped for comfort in any weather, with seating, a fly bridge deck, lounge, and bathrooms.
extraNote: Cancellation: 50% refund if cancelled at least 30 days in advance; no refund within 30 days · Cruise rain or shine; vessel fully enclosed and comfortable in any weather · Captain may terminate cruise if unsafe conditions arise including weather or passenger behavior · Please arrive 10 minutes prior to departure; parking available but public transport recommended · AGC Marina lower parking lot and guest dock, 1200 Westlake Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109
